entries.speaker: Chihaya

entries.speaker: Chihaya

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've realized... what may first seem like[n]an obstacle can actually be a valuable,[n]meaningful stepping stone.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: If I hadn't left my hometown and ended[n]up here, I couldn't have used my powers[n]to help people.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: And... more importantly, I'd never[n]have met you, [lName]-san.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Then again, it seems like you have[n]the power to bring joy to anyone's[n]fate.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I understand now. We don't have to[n]cling to fate—we can change it with[n]our own hands.
